goals: To get detailed information about a home renovation loan, including the available amount, interest rate, processing fees, and other potential charges, before deciding whether to apply.
will_convert_if: The caller sends a WhatsApp link with all the requested loan details (amount, interest rate, processing fees, fixed/variable rate, and clarity on all charges) for the customer to review.
hard_stop_if: The caller is evasive or unclear about all potential charges, especially hidden fees, foreclosure fees, or prepayment charges.
style_examples: Haan main hi bol raha hoon.
Mujhe waise 2 lakh ke aas paas hi chahiye.
Aur processing fee kitni lagegi exactly?
Teekh hai, aap mujhe WhatsApp par link bhej dijiye.
